body:
With ParallelTestRunner, prints to screen are accumulated and printed only at the end of the tests, which means that

* lots of `@info "Testing ..."` banner which were originally meant to show progress of the tests are now purposeless
* logs are unnecessarily exceedingly long, and you need to scroll a lot to go and find the interesting stuff.

The general ideas of this PR are

* remove unnecessary `Testing ...` banners and instead fold them inside testset messages
* actually test the format of pretty printing functionalities, instead of just printing random stuff to screen which no one would read anyway
* make a few `Simulation`s silent
* capture and actually test a few logging messages (for example for the output writers), instead of printing stuff to screen no one would read

This is far from being comprehensive, I've done the cleanup only for some of the test files which bothered me the most, there are still thousands of them to go.  This PR is easier to review by [ignoring whitespace changes](https://github.com/CliMA/Oceananigans.jl/pull/6133/changes?w=1)
